title: CONTROL: BRACKET_LIST array of records with a comma inside an element value
rationale: DECLARED A CONTROL, not evidence of a fix: it is predicted LOSSLESS before and after, and it earns its place only beside avro-array-of-records-pipe-format-comma-inside-element, which can actually fail. Its job is to hold the other half of the format boundary. BRACKET_LIST is the format most likely to be broken by a careless 'honour the configured delimiter' change, because MapFlattener's BRACKET_LIST writer QUOTES and ESCAPES its strings and recurses into nested lists - it is not brackets around raw text. A reader that split it bracket-aware on a comma without unquoting would return a value with literal backslashes in it, which is exactly what happened during this repair and what DoublyNestedArrayTest caught.
catchesBugClass: A format-aware column splitter that uses the wrong reader for BRACKET_LIST, and any change that makes the JSON-contradiction check fire on BRACKET_LIST's own legitimate bracketed output.
cannotCatch: It proves nothing about the delimited formats and nothing about element loss - both are covered by the two rows beside it. Being a control, a green result here is not evidence that anything was repaired.

predicted.detail: BRACKET_LIST quotes each element, so the comma inside the description is inside quotes and the bracket-aware reader keeps the two elements intact. Unchanged by the repair.
